location_lifecycle.label: Clinic Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a clinic or treatment location. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The clinic or treatment location is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The clinic or treatment location is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The clinic or treatment location is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the clinic or treatment location are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the clinic or treatment location.
